source: weevboss-official.png, approved original supplied by Gepetto
method: Built-in image_gen background-extraction, two edit passes
prompt: Remove the white background, preserve the complete isometric weevil silhouette and all block vertices. True RGBA transparency, no white matte or halo. Uniform top/front/side planes, no texture, reflection, shadow or new geometry. Center the complete mark with transparent padding.
cleanupPrompt: Preserve every polygon vertex; use flat top/front/side colours, remove floating pixels and all background, antialias only with adjacent plane colour and alpha.
rendering: One PNG shared by every theme. One small SVG wrapper crops it, removes alpha below 0.1 and flattens its three face tones. The --logo-filter CSS token applies brightness/grayscale/invert/sepia only to this logo, never its parent or background.
palette: Four --logo-filter values in src/styles.css; contrast >=3 on main and project bands in all four themes. No per-theme bitmap or SVG copies.
